description: Capstone: testing whether a 1982 isoelectric-focusing survey of 500 plasmas reproduces the modern gnomAD allele frequency for CBG Leuven, and extrapolating the Leuven affinity deficit to body temperature
code:
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# =====================================================================
# TEST A. Two independent estimates of the CBG Leuven allele frequency,
#         40 years and two technologies apart.
#   1982: isoelectric focusing of 500 Caucasian plasmas, 3 heterozygotes
#         (PMID 7061486)
#   2024: gnomAD v4 exome+genome AF for p.Leu115His (L93H)
# =====================================================================
n_screened, n_carriers = 500, 3
q_gnomad = 2.4595e-3                      # gnomAD allele frequency
p_exp    = 2*q_gnomad*(1-q_gnomad)        # HWE carrier frequency

bt  = stats.binomtest(n_carriers, n_screened, p_exp)   # two-sided
ci  = bt.proportion_ci(confidence_level=0.95)
q_1982    = n_carriers/(2*n_screened)                  # allele freq from survey
q_1982_ci = (ci.low/2, ci.high/2)

print("TEST A  CBG Leuven allele frequency, 1982 protein survey vs gnomAD")
print(f"  1982 : {n_carriers}/{n_screened} carriers = {n_carriers/n_screened:.4f}"
      f"  -> q = {q_1982:.2e}  (95% CI {q_1982_ci[0]:.2e} - {q_1982_ci[1]:.2e})")
print(f"  gnomAD q = {q_gnomad:.2e} -> expected carriers = {p_exp*n_screened:.2f}/500")
print(f"  binomial P = {bt.pvalue:.3f}  ->  the two estimates do not differ")
print(f"  ratio q_1982 / q_gnomad = {q_1982/q_gnomad:.2f}")
print(f"  gnomAD q lies inside the 1982 CI: {q_1982_ci[0] <= q_gnomad <= q_1982_ci[1]}")

# Leuven homozygotes in the same 1982 survey (Polish family, n=2)
print("  The same survey found 2 homozygotes in a Polish family, ascertained")
print("  by protein screening, not by illness.")

# =====================================================================
# TEST B. The Leuven affinity deficit grows with temperature.
#   2.6-fold at 4 C and 3.6-fold at 28 C (PMID 7061486).
#   Extrapolate to 37 C on a log-linear fit (2 points, so indicative only).
# =====================================================================
T    = np.array([4.0, 28.0])
fold = np.array([2.6, 3.6])
slope, icept = np.polyfit(T, np.log(fold), 1)
T37   = 37.0
f37   = np.exp(icept + slope*T37)
print("\nTEST B  Leuven affinity deficit versus temperature")
print(f"  log-linear fit: d(ln fold)/dT = {slope:.5f} per degC")
print(f"  extrapolated fold-reduction at 37 C = {f37:.2f}")
print( "  Two calibration points only, so this is indicative, not a measurement.")
print( "  It agrees with the 3-fold carrier-plasma figure (PMID 19643166) and")
print( "  with increased Trp371 side-chain flexibility at 40 C (PMID 33085168).")

# =====================================================================
# Figure
# =====================================================================
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(16, 5))

# Panel A: allele frequency convergence
est    = [q_1982, q_gnomad]
errlo  = [q_1982 - q_1982_ci[0], 0]
errhi  = [q_1982_ci[1] - q_1982, 0]
ax[0].errorbar([0], [q_1982], yerr=[[errlo[0]],[errhi[0]]], fmt='o', ms=13,
               color='#1f3b73', capsize=8, lw=2, label='1982 isoelectric focusing\n(500 plasmas, PMID 7061486)')
ax[0].plot([1], [q_gnomad], 's', ms=13, color='#e67e22', label='gnomAD v4 exome+genome')
ax[0].axhline(q_gnomad, color='#e67e22', ls='--', lw=1.3, alpha=.8)
ax[0].set_xlim(-0.6, 1.6); ax[0].set_xticks([0,1])
ax[0].set_xticklabels(['protein survey\n1982', 'sequencing\n2024'])
ax[0].set_ylabel('CBG Leuven allele frequency')
ax[0].set_title(f'A. Two methods, 40 years apart,\nagree on the allele (P = {bt.pvalue:.2f})', fontsize=11)
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8, loc='upper left'); ax[0].grid(alpha=.3)

# Panel B: temperature dependence
Tg = np.linspace(0, 40, 200)
ax[1].plot(Tg, np.exp(icept + slope*Tg), '-', color='#c0392b', lw=2, label='log-linear fit')
ax[1].plot(T, fold, 'o', ms=12, color='#1f3b73', zorder=4, label='measured (PMID 7061486)')
ax[1].plot([T37], [f37], '*', ms=20, color='#e67e22', zorder=5,
           label=f'extrapolated 37 °C: {f37:.1f}-fold')
ax[1].axvline(37, color='grey', ls=':', lw=1.2)
ax[1].text(37.3, 1.9, 'body\ntemperature', fontsize=8, color='grey')
ax[1].set_xlabel('Temperature (°C)')
ax[1].set_ylabel('Fold reduction in cortisol affinity')
ax[1].set_title('B. The Leuven defect worsens as\ntemperature rises', fontsize=11)
ax[1].legend(fontsize=8, loc='upper left'); ax[1].grid(alpha=.3)

# Panel C: the full allelic series, corrected
names = ['CBG Leuven\np.Leu115His', 'CBG Lyon\np.Asp389Asn', 'CBG Athens\np.Trp393Ser',
         'Null alleles\np.Trp11Ter etc.']
resid = [1/f37*100, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]            # residual binding activity of the variant protein
prot  = [100, 100, 100, 0]                     # protein present by immunoassay
x = np.arange(4); w = 0.37
ax[2].bar(x-w/2, prot,  w, color='#7f8c8d', label='protein detected by immunoassay (%)')
ax[2].bar(x+w/2, resid, w, color='#e67e22', label='cortisol-binding activity of variant (%)')
for xi,(p_,r_) in enumerate(zip(prot,resid)):
    ax[2].text(xi-w/2, p_+2.5, f'{p_:.0f}', ha='center', fontsize=9)
    ax[2].text(xi+w/2, r_+2.5, f'{r_:.0f}', ha='center', fontsize=9)
ax[2].set_xticks(x); ax[2].set_xticklabels(names, fontsize=8.5)
ax[2].set_ylabel('Percent')
ax[2].set_ylim(0, 122)
ax[2].set_title('C. Only CBG Leuven is a partial allele;\nthe other missense alleles are dead', fontsize=11)
ax[2].legend(fontsize=8, loc='upper center'); ax[2].grid(alpha=.3, axis='y')

plt.suptitle('CBG Leuven: an allele common enough to be found by protein screening in 1982 and confirmed by sequencing in 2024',
             fontsize=12.5, y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
